meta.why_oklch: Laravel derives every -foreground pairing from the supplied surface colour's OKLCH lightness (tailwind-shadcn). Contrast is computed by us, never chosen by the customer, so the stored colour space has to be perceptual — that is the reason for OKLCH, not fashion.
meta.browser_baseline: Safari 16.4 / Chrome 111 / Firefox 128. An unsupported colour function invalidates the whole declaration, so an older device renders a transparent surface with black text and no error.
meta.derivation: .claude/skills/kb-design-language/references/tokens.md carries the derivation of every value below — the contrast floor each pair must clear and which are load-bearing. When that file and this one disagree, THIS file wins and that one is stale.
meta.canvas_card_gap: The light-mode canvas/card lightness gap is 0.055 OKLCH. The shadow ladder is tuned against that number; changing --canvas means re-tuning every shadow. It is not an independent knob.
meta.measured_corrections_2026_08_18: SIX values here differ from kb-design-language -> references/tokens.md, and the difference is a measurement rather than a preference. That file states its contrast figures were derived analytically and names the CI checker as the authority; apps/web/tests/unit/design-system.test.ts is now that checker, and on its first run six pairs missed their floor. Each was corrected by moving LIGHTNESS ONLY, in the smallest step that clears the floor, preserving hue and chroma: --border-strong light 0.660 -> 0.628 (was 2.649:1 on --canvas, floor 3), --warning light 0.650 -> 0.636 (2.851:1 on --canvas), --chart-2 light 0.700 -> 0.683 (2.819:1 on --card), --chart-4 light 0.780 -> 0.670 (2.007:1), --chart-6 light 0.680 -> 0.663 (2.815:1), and --primary dark 0.585 -> 0.568 (--primary-foreground measured 4.202:1 on it, floor 4.5). The chart series still clear the >=0.06 adjacent-lightness rule after the change (deltas 0.138, 0.108, 0.095, 0.165, 0.158), which is the property that survives greyscale and CVD and is the reason the order is not shuffleable. references/tokens.md is now stale in those six rows by its own rule: tokens.json wins.

_radiusScale_note: The max(0px, …) wrappers are load-bearing, not defensive style: 0rem is in the tenant enum, a negative border-radius is an invalid value, and the browser drops the WHOLE declaration rather than clamping. Nothing warns.
_tenantOverridable_note: The CLOSED set of custom properties a bot's theme_configuration may move (docs/11 §16.3). A key absent here can never reach the DOM whatever Laravel returns. The tenant supplies primary, accent and radius; the two -foreground values are DERIVED from the surface lightness and are listed because they are written to the DOM, not because a form may set them. The rest of the accent ramp (primary-hover, primary-active, primary-soft, primary-soft-foreground) is derived at render from --primary and is deliberately NOT in this list — a tenant may not set it directly.
_link_note: --link and --link-active exist because --primary CANNOT BE A TEXT COLOUR AND A FILL AT THE SAME TIME, and in dark mode it was neither (finding R1). It carries two floors that pull in opposite directions — white --primary-foreground on it needs it dark, body-sized text on --canvas needs it light — and in dark mode the feasible windows DO NOT OVERLAP: at C 0.215 H 264 no lightness clears both, measured at 0.568 (3.95 / 4.52), 0.600 (4.53 / 3.95) and 0.640 (5.18 / 3.45). So this is not a value anyone can tune; it is a second token or nothing. Links were on .text-primary at 14 call sites plus Button's `link` variant, which is every link in the admin console: 3.95:1 on --canvas, 3.54 on --card, 3.15 on --card-inset, against a 4.5 floor. THE VALUES ARE var() ALIASES ON PURPOSE, exactly as --ring is: a custom property holding a var() is substituted at the ELEMENT that uses it, so --link follows a tenant's derived accent ramp inside bot-theme-scope, which a literal oklch() copied out of the ramp would not. --primary-soft-foreground clears 4.5:1 on every surface in both modes with room to spare (light 7.06 / 8.29 / 7.74, dark 9.76 / 8.73 / 7.77 on canvas / card / card-inset) and needs no new colour; --primary-active is the pressed step and clears everywhere too (light 7.55+, dark 6.66 / 5.96 / 5.30). NEITHER IS TENANT-OVERRIDABLE and neither may be added to tenantOverridable: they are aliases of properties that are already derived, so a tenant setting --link directly would break the one relationship this note exists to preserve. The contrast matrix in apps/web/tests/unit/design-system.test.ts now carries an ACCENT-AS-TEXT row that resolves these aliases; without it the next correction to --primary can re-break links exactly the way the first one did (it moved --primary dark 0.585 -> 0.568 to fix text ON primary, and cost link text 0.30 of its ratio, invisibly, because the matrix had a row for one direction and not the other).
_legacyColors_note: DEPRECATED shadcn-inheritance names, emitted at their PRE-MIGRATION values and used by NOTHING in apps/web. They exist for exactly one reason: apps/widget/src/app/styles.css aliases --background, --card-foreground and --muted under its own @theme inline, and apps/widget is outside admin-web-engineer's boundary. Removing them is widget-sdk-engineer's, together with the tokens.widget.css subset that does not exist yet. Do not use one in new code, and do not 'fix' their values to match the new palette — a legacy alias that silently changes colour is worse than one that is obviously stale.
_shadows_note: The shadow colour is the FOREGROUND, not black — a neutral-black shadow on a cool canvas goes muddy. Every dark step carries an inset oklch(1 0 0 / α) ring, and that ring rather than the shadow is what separates a dark card from a dark canvas; a component that hardcodes the light-mode string looks borderless in dark, not merely flatter.
_type_note: Each step ships four values and they TRAVEL TOGETHER. Taking --text-h1's size while leaving tracking at 0 is how a heading ends up almost right. The build emits them as Tailwind v4 paired sub-variables (--text-h1--line-height etc.) so `text-h1` sets all four and splitting them requires deliberate effort.
_motion_note: dur-1 colour/hover/press/focus · dur-2 popover/tooltip/chip/accordion/toast · dur-3 dialog/sheet/drawer/sidebar · dur-4 route transition/chart draw-in/skeleton crossfade. ease-spring is for toggles and checkboxes ONLY. Tailwind v4 has no --duration-* theme namespace, so components reach these as duration-(--dur-2), which contains no literal ms.
